messages:
mira: Deploy-bot just flagged ap-south p95 spike and scheduled auto-revert in 3m. Thoughts?
deploy-bot: ALERT: region ap-south rollout p95 480ms (+260ms) and 4.2% 5xx over 2m. Auto-revert scheduled in 3m. Use /deploybot ack to suppress.
ken: Let's not let it auto fire. Suppress and investigate traces. If it's sustained >3m or control-slice error >1%, we'll do a manual rollback.
mira: Agreed. I'm suppressing with owner and TTL. ```/deploybot ack suppress --thread 1799123458 --by mira --reason "investigate routing regression" --until 2026-05-10T15:10:00Z```
deploy-bot: CONFIRMED: suppression by mira until 2026-05-10T15:10:00Z (sup-7c9d). Monitoring continues.
tara: Quick check: traces show a surge in request serialization time after the commit that toggled batching threshold. Appears correlated with >1500 token requests.
ken: That matches a recent change. Plan: staged rollback for ap-south only to v2.14.8: 15% -> 40% -> 100% with 5m steps. Jorge please prep customer note for large EU and AP tenants.
jorge: Drafting: "We detected elevated errors for ap region after a recent release. We're rolling back the region to restore service. No action required; ETA ~20m." Will send after rollback completes.
mira: Execute staged rollback. ```/deploybot rollout set-version --region ap-south --version v2.14.8 --traffic 15% --staged --step-duration 300s --thread 1799123458```
deploy-bot: ACTION: Started staged rollback to v2.14.8 in ap-south. Step 1: 15% -> monitoring.
tara: After step 1 p95 down to 210ms, 5xxs 0.8%. Cache miss spike but warmed quickly.
ken: Proceed to 40%. ```/deploybot rollout continue --to 40% --thread 1799123458```
deploy-bot: ACTION: Advanced to 40% at 2026-05-10T15:04:20Z.
jorge: Account teams notified for BigRetail and AnalyticsCo; they acknowledged.
mira: Finish to 100% and pin for 8h. ```/deploybot rollout continue --to 100% --thread 1799123458 && /deploybot pin-version --region ap-south --version v2.14.8 --duration 8h```
deploy-bot: ACTION: Rollback completed to 100% at 2026-05-10T15:09:59Z. Pin applied for 8h. Metrics: p95 185ms, 5xx 0.2%.
ken: Nice. Follow-ups: open postmortem, add alert for batching-threshold regressions, and update release notes with the rollback rationale.
mira: I'll own the postmortem and include the exact trace links and the suppression ID. Thanks team. :thumbsup:"
